PRAGMA COLLISION RESOLVED BY #pragma defer_codegen off, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED. Three configurations of this same 39-function source were compiled and byte-compared. (a) file-global `opt_strength_reduction off`: 34/39, DIFF at ROM ordinals 12, 13, 19, 30, 35. (b) no optimisation pragma at all: 34/39, DIFF at ordinals 13, 15, 16, 19, 38. The two DIFF sets are disjoint apart from 13 and 19, which is the delete-outright positive control: the pragma demonstrably moves bytes at file scope, so a bracket test on it can carry signal. (c) `#pragma defer_codegen off` plus an ascending-ROM-order rewrite, with `opt_strength_reduction off` bracketed around ordinals 15, 16 and 38 and both it and `opt_loop_invariants off` around ordinal 13: 38/39, and the brackets bind per function -- ordinals 12, 30 and 35 stay matching outside them. Deferred codegen is why these pragmas are otherwise file-global last-wins; with it off they bind positionally, and mwccarm then emits .text in source order, which is why the source is written ascending.

The last DIFF, dScMgSlot3_c_classInit at ordinal 19, was a real relocation defect and not a byte difference: tools/objisolate.py refused `_ZTV12dScMgSlot3_c: unexpected reloc type=2 addend=0`. Because this TU defines dScMgSlot3_c's key function it also EMITS that class's vtable, and mwccarm's _ZTV symbol addresses the vtable object, two words of ABI preamble ahead of the slot array that config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt names. The machine-shaped C shard inherited the importing-TU spelling (+0), which in an emitting TU points 8 bytes early. Rewriting that one store as &_ZTV12dScMgSlot3_c[2] took the unit to 39/39 with objisolate clean. The dScMgSingle3DBase_c store beside it stays at +0 because that vtable is only imported here. Same rule, opposite side, as src/game/actors/daTrs_c/d_a_trs_factories.cpp.

ROOT CAUSE of the linkcheck refusal recorded above, measured: src/_ZN12dScMgSlot3_c13InitResourcesEv.cpp (ROM ordinal 18) is enrolled without `complete` because tools/eligible.py rejects it under rule 5 -- `unresolvable: func_020bc8b4`. That name is declared `extern int func_020bc8b4;` in include/decl_common.h and written as data by the body, but no config/**/symbols.txt defines it, so an isolated object would bind it weakly to 0. The address itself is genuinely ambiguous, not missing: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/relocs.txt records `from:0x0210c114 kind:load to:0x020bc8b4 module:overlays(0,2,4)`, and three different overlays name that address -- data_ov000_020bc8b4 (itself marked `ambiguous`), daObjHeart_c_classInit in ov002, and data_ov004_020bc8b4. Picking one is an overlay-residency question this entry has no evidence for, and the same unresolved name blocks src/_ZN12dScMgSlot1_c13InitResourcesEv.cpp (from:0x0210d6a4, the same destination) in the sibling ov006/dScMgSlot1_c unit, so settling it is a decl_common.h change spanning both units, not a change to this TU. Until it is settled, linkcheck cannot run and this entry stays text-verified.

SECOND, INDEPENDENT promotion blocker, so fixing the enrollment above alone will not promote this entry: tools/tu_promote.py --dry-run refuses with "'src/actors/dScMgSlot1_c+dScMgSlot3_c.cpp' has a character the linker command file cannot carry unquoted; rename the file before promoting". The `+` multi-class naming convention is safe for src_tu/ -- nothing links those -- but dsd writes bare unquoted object names into the LCF and mwldarm's parser treats `+` as punctuation. This entry's promoted_source must be renamed to a `+`-free path before promotion, which is a separate decision about what the two-class file should be called.
